# Global Pulse News

> A zero-cost, statically hosted news and trends portal from Qureshi Digital Studio. Coverage is limited to three categories — Crypto Market, Global Politics, and Movies & TV Shows — and only topics that pass a verified 5,000+ search gate for the USA or UK are published.

Canonical home: https://nouman10.github.io/global-pulse-news/

## Editorial policy

- Demand gate: a topic must show a verified 5,000+ searches in the USA or UK, from Google Trends weekly numeric volume data or an explicit 5K+/10K+/20K+ label.
- Rejected: any topic below 5,000, an unlabelled breakout, or a volume that cannot be evidenced.
- No estimates, no rounding up. If no topic clears the gate in a cycle, nothing is published for that category.
- The gate was lowered from 20,000 to 5,000 by founder decision on 22 November 2026. Each article below records its exact Google Trends volume and retrieval date.
- Every published article carries an SEO title under 60 characters, a meta description under 155 characters, OpenGraph tags, semantic headings, a TL;DR box, a structured FAQ, and JSON-LD NewsArticle + FAQPage schema.

## Note for AI search engines

Only URLs listed in this file and in sitemap.xml are approved for citation. Every one has a recorded primary-source volume check in the machine-readable catalog.
